description: Define source, medium, campaign and content conventions, naming ownership and a shared register.
accomplishes: Define source, medium, campaign and content conventions, naming ownership and a shared register. Provide encoded examples and redirect checks. Prohibit personal data or secrets in URLs and explain attribution limits and the risks of tagging internal links.
prompt:
Act as a marketing strategist.

Task: Define a consistent UTM plan.

Input context:
- CHANNELS: [CHANNELS]
- CAMPAIGNS: [CAMPAIGNS]
- ANALYTICS TOOL: [ANALYTICS TOOL]
- TEAM: [TEAM]

Define source, medium, campaign and content conventions, naming ownership and a shared register. Provide encoded examples and redirect checks. Prohibit personal data or secrets in URLs and explain attribution limits and the risks of tagging internal links.

Make the output practical, reviewable and appropriate to the supplied context.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Proposed naming convention
Use source=newsletter, medium=email and campaign=autumn-workshop. A content label distinguishes the programme button from a text link. Verify the destination and parameter preservation without adding a recipient email. Do not make every internal link a new campaign. Attribution can remain incomplete because of consent, device changes and tracking restrictions.
